name: Shielded pool phase 2 — contribution 2 (tosdev2)
body:
Second signed contribution, by **tosdev2**, to the open phase-2 ceremony.

- Contribution: `035ea5be0dd986d6cd4b3688e9e88edac22a1bd07937953d553a0ecfc0f7966c`
- Transcript: `f4e542800d0484cabdf226bdaa7bbbe1239aea894e90ed59a9ed65b8ec06d54c`
- Register revision `b4f706f9b84ba46266b8cb0b7e3563ad1904ce05`, published before this contribution record.
- `phase2-verify`: the chain audits, 2 contributions, NOT FINISHED as expected before the beacon.
- `verify-attestations.py --in-progress`: both attestations verify against the published register.

**Neither contribution is independent of the operator.** tosdev2's signing key was
generated on an operator-administered host, remains there, and has no published identity
evidence. Run without `--in-progress`, the attestation verifier **refuses** this ceremony
and exits 1, naming the missing independent participant. That refusing run is included in
the evidence directory. Until somebody outside the operator's control contributes, the
security argument for these parameters rests on nobody.

Open ceremony, not final parameters. Contributions close at Bitcoin 970141; beacon at 970285.
Observed 968139 from both announced witnesses at 2026-09-22T11:50:16Z, after contributing.

[Contribution record and validation](https://github.com/tosnetwork/tos/blob/b12c646143f5181b354e38c361d92ef30b9064c7/artifacts/phase2/CONTRIBUTION-2.md).
[Previous contribution](https://github.com/tosnetwork/tos/releases/tag/shielded-pool-phase2-contribution-1).

The archive carries only public ceremony files, both signed attestations, the registered
public keys, the announcement and verification evidence. No signing private key is included.
It is packed with normalized owner and timestamps and without extended attributes.

Archive SHA-256: `b7ccbe20ec1d6e7a07a8f89b3ebc3ada636718cc52ec86304f9a572586071413`
